```js
if (!publishNpm) return rollback(newVersion)
```

The `return` keyword explicitly stops the execution here?

I did some functions before, it was harder to read because going to reference to references. Since it's a script I wanted something straightforward that you can read like a text from the top to the bottom without jumping elsewhere to avoid mistakes when we will work on it again.

The "safest" way is to:

```shell
rm -rf node_modules docgen/node_modules && 
    yarn cache clean &&
    yarn

cd docgen && yarn
```

This way we will have no cache, same packages as described into the `yarn.lock` and `package.json`
